$comment: Tool contract for the on-board agent capability layer. Only the four tools below are exposed to a model. Issuing a credential, arming it, revoking it and reading the audit log stay with the operator (root Basic) and are deliberately absent: a model that can mint its own authority is not sandboxed.

function.name: observe
function.description: Read the vehicle state before acting, and after any surprise. Returns speed/steer targets and measured values, whether wheel feedback is fresh, the latched fault if any, whether actuation is currently possible, and this credential's own envelope. Call this before proposing a plan; do not invent state.

function.name: drive
function.description: Publish one bounded motion primitive: drive at v m/s with differential steer for ttl_ms. The command is a lease, not a setting: it expires after ttl_ms unless refreshed, and an expired lease stops the vehicle and latches a fault that only an operator can clear. Prefer producing a plan for scripts/agent_drive.py over calling this directly in a loop.

v.description: Forward speed in m/s. Also limited by the credential's v_max, which is usually lower.

steer.description: Half the left/right wheel-speed difference in m/s, positive = left wheel faster = turn right. Yaw rate is approximately 2*steer / wheel_track.

ttl_ms.description: Lease duration. 500 is the maximum; 300-500 is the sensible range at 5-8 Hz.

returns.traveled_m: number, metres consumed against the credential budget
returns.actuation: live|blocked; blocked means the command was accepted but an interlock refused it

function.name: stop
function.description: End motion and retire the arming. The follow profile is switched off as well, so the vehicle cannot fall back to chasing a detected target. Use this at the end of every plan and whenever the situation is unclear.

function.name: estop
function.description: Emergency stop. Disarms, stops, and forces the follow profile off on disk so a service restart cannot bring it back. Use when the vehicle is doing something you did not intend; a human must re-enable before anything moves again.

error_codes.403: credential not armed, or missing scope
error_codes.409: profile disabled, fault latched, or distance budget exhausted
error_codes.422: argument outside the credential envelope or outside the control-layer hard cap
error_codes.429: more than 25 commands per second on one credential
